scenes.headline: How to mix attention one head at a time
scenes.sub: HydraHead keeps full attention only where retrieval actually lives.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Pickles! Full attention is exact but quadratic. Linear attention is cheap but forgets. HydraHead mixes them somewhere new.

scenes.text: Long-range retrieval lives in a few scattered heads, not in whole layers. So keep full attention for those heads, and make the rest linear.
scenes.say: Retrieval lives in a few scattered heads, not whole layers. So keep full attention for those heads, and make the rest linear.

steps.label: The usual hybrid: whole layers
steps.say: The usual hybrid gives whole layers full attention, at a fixed ratio. But layers change smoothly, with no clean seam to cut.

steps.label: Retrieval heads: about 6.5%, scattered
steps.say: Heads don't. In Qwen3 1.7B, only about six and a half percent of query heads are essential for retrieval.

steps.label: HydraHead: about 25% of heads keep full attention
steps.say: So HydraHead picks per head. About a quarter keep full attention; the rest become Gated DeltaNet, a linear attention.

items.say: Take a needle-in-a-haystack probe, and swap the needle for a same-length distractor.
Patch each head back in, and score how much it restores the right answer.

items.text: Rank all heads, keep the top
items.say: Rank the heads and keep the top ones. About six samples are enough.

scenes.title: One layer, two kinds of head

steps.say: Each layer now runs both kinds of head, side by side.
Softmax outputs are sharp and linear ones are smooth, so each head gets its own RMS norm.
Then a learned scale per head, before the shared output projection.

steps.note: no norm: extended-context RULER drops from 87.5 to 71.4
steps.say: Drop the norm, and the extended-context score falls from eighty-seven point five to seventy-one point four.

scenes.title: RULER single-needle, 256K context
scenes.note: reported at the 1.7B scale; the tables stop at 256K
scenes.say: At two hundred fifty-six thousand tokens, HydraHead finds the needle ninety-four point five three percent of the time. The base model: zero.

scenes.text: The head, not the layer, is the right unit for spending a quadratic attention budget.
scenes.say: The head, not the layer, is the right unit for spending a quadratic attention budget.

recap: Retrieval lives in a few scattered heads
Causal patching picks which heads keep full attention
Per-head norm and scale fuse the two kinds
scenes.say: To recap: find the retrieval heads by patching, keep them exact, and make the rest linear.
